caption:
🗣️ Do you need German to work in Germany? Only 26% of the 4,539 English-speaking job ads on Stellenly require it:

• Not needed, or just a plus: 12%
• Not mentioned at all: 61%
• German required: 26%

"Not mentioned" usually means the team works in English, but German still helps in daily life, so ask in the interview. Every job on Stellenly shows its German level, with the exact quote from the posting.
